items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement compares the internal hom constructions for the two neighbourhoods attached to an ideal and its extension under a ring map (author lemma at source lines 1718-1735, label lemma-neighbourhood-extensions). The proof (source lines 1737-1759) replaces both complexes by their local cohomology using power-torsionness of the cohomology, identifies the two local cohomology objects under base change and finishes with the comparison statement for those (proof lines 1737-1758). The two reductions are the substance. H3.
